Proven in high-volume, SLA-driven environments, maintaining 99.5% data accuracy and reducing overdue onboarding requests while supporting Transaction Banking, Client Enablement and cross-functional Stakeholder Management.

raw_sections.experience:
Professional Experience
Citi | Data Operations Analyst | Aug 2024 – Present
Managed 150+ client interaction records daily across Bloomberg, Dealogic, CorpAxe, Commcise and S&P platforms, sustaining 99.5% submission accuracy and supporting reliable end-to-end data delivery.
Gathered and analysed business requirements with Global Sales, Research, Operations and Technology teams; translated ambiguous data issues into clear validation rules, workflows and actionable change requirements while supporting effective Stakeholder Management.
Identified duplicate and inaccurate corporate-access records and executed controlled remediation for management visits, roadshows, conferences, field trips and special events.
Executed User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for automation and AI-enabled initiatives, including Citi Stylus and Copilot, by reviewing expected outcomes, documenting test scenarios, validating results and providing sign-off inputs within the agreed TAT.
Maintained sales coverage mapping and vendor reference data for 200+ corporate clients, ensuring data consistency across global systems as the single point of contact for queries.
Deutsche Bank | Client Implementation Analyst | Aug 2022 – Dec 2023
Managed end-to-end Client Implementation and Client Onboarding, periodic reviews, account opening, maintenance and documentation refresh for 100+ global Corporate Banking clients across APAC, including India and Singapore.
Served as Subject Matter Expert (SME) on AML/KYC documentation requirements, acting as the primary escalation point for compliance queries, documentation gaps and regulatory clarifications.
Processed system-generated authorisation forms, verified signatures against board resolutions, archived documentation in DB cloud systems and executed client requests with 100% compliance adherence.
Leveraged Salesforce CRM and other reporting tools to track onboarding pipelines, monitor KPIs and pending approvals, and flag ageing items, reducing overdue requests through proactive follow-ups.
Maintained real-time visibility of outstanding items, chased internal approvals and delivered timely status updates, supporting effective Client Servicing and Stakeholder Management while managing direct client communication professionally.
Supported high-volume onboarding operations with strong attention to detail, escalating AML/KYC risks, including sanctions-screening flags, to Compliance within defined SLAs.
Collaborated with Sales, Trading, Operations and onshore teams to clarify business requirements and ensure successful client onboarding within agreed TAT benchmarks.
Kotak Mahindra Bank | Assistant Manager | Feb 2020 – Jul 2022
Coordinated account setup, maintenance and closure for cash-management products within Transaction Banking and Cash & Trade, serving 200+ corporate banking clients while ensuring strict alignment with internal controls and operational procedures.
Monitored daily operational queues across in-process and pending cases, achieving 98% on-time closure within Billing Operations SLAs and ensuring transactions were executed accurately and on time.
Prepared and delivered comprehensive MIS reports to senior leadership, supporting executive decision-making for the corporate portfolio.
Onboarded corporate clients to payment and collection services, including NACH mandates, NEFT, RTGS, IMPS, UPI, BBPS, cheque processing and cash-pickup solutions. Supported Channel Implementation across Digital Banking, Internet Banking, E-banking, H2H, API and SWIFT connectivity, and resolved implementation and transaction- related queries.
Supported Client Enablement through practical Customer Training and User Training on digital-channel access, maker-checker workflows and service usage while providing ongoing Client Servicing and Customer Support.
Prepared MIS and operational-status reports for senior leadership, supporting governance reviews, workload prioritisation, issue escalation and decision-making.
